Biography

When Wanda was held prisoner in the Sakrohm Gulag, one of her unfortunate comrades died due to the negligence of a jailer. A memory that still haunts her today. So, even though she has always enjoyed the company of her Pussycats sisters, Wanda has never tolerated the disorganization of the city against which even the feminists do nothing. While maintaining her connections with the Pussycats, she has joined the Tolvack, of which she has become a fervent ambassador. As a seductive diplomat, Frau Vanda now takes on the task of charming the powerful, turning the cold and practical revolution of the Tolvack into an attractive prospect. Thus, through her actions, power may fall into the hands of rigorous and competent people.
